SPECIFICATION FOR TRIPOD CONNECTIONS, PHOTOGRAPHIC
1. S c o p e -- Specifies material, form and dimensions of screw connections used between a camera and a tripod or other accessories. 2. Material -- Aluminium alloy conforming to designation 6 4 4 2 3 or 64430 of IS : 7 3 3 - 1 9 8 3 'Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy bars, rods and sections (for general engineering purposes ) ( third revision )' or an equivalent material.
N o t e -- T h e h a r d n e s s o f t h e e q u i v a l e n t material shall b e s u c h a s n o t t o s p o i l t h e c a m e r a o r w e a r o u t w i t h u s a g e .

Photographic Equipment Sectional Committee, CPDC 31; Photo Equipment Subcommittee, CPDC 31 :3 [ Ref:: Doc: CPDC 31 (1700) ]

3. Form, Basic D i m e n s i o n s , Deviation s and Tolerances -- The form and dimensions of the connections shall be as shown in Fig. 1 and 2 and Tables 1 and 2.

All d i m e n s i o n s in m i l l i m e t r e s . FIG. 1 D I M E N S I O N S OF N U T A N D BOLT
